title: A Repeated Measurements Approach to $SoH$ Battery Modelling of Cyclic Aged Data in a Laboratory Environment
abstract: arXiv:2608.19879v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This document describes the application of a first order linearised nonlinear repeated measurements approach to the analysis of battery cell ageing profiles generated under controlled conditions in a laboratory. The primary advantage of the model is it reflects the obvious structure in the data. Consequently, it is a two-component of variance model: variation within ageing profiles (measurement noise) and variation among ageing profiles (test-to-test or cell-to-cell) variation. Novel regularised iterative generalised least squares parameter identification schemes, with optimal hyper-parameter re-estimation, are used to identify the hierarchical nonlinear model. The training data comprised $SoH$ profiles for 10 cells aged at various constant discharge and charge current cycles at a fixed chamber environmental temperature of 25 [$^\circ$C]. translated_title: 实验室环境中循环老化数据的电池健康状态建模的重复测量方法
translated_abstract: 本文档描述了将一阶线性化非线性重复测量方法应用于实验室受控条件下生成的电池单元老化曲线分析。该模型的主要优势在于它反映了数据中的明显结构。因此，它是一个双分量方差模型：老化曲线内的变异（测量噪声）和老化曲线间的变异（测试间或单元间）变异。新颖的正则化迭代广义最小二乘参数识别方案，结合最优超参数重新估计，用于识别分层非线性模型。训练数据包括在固定环境温度25°C下，以各种恒定放电和充电电流循环老化的10个电池单元的$SoH$曲线。每个电池单元的$SoH$曲线使用简单的幂律表达式建模，而变异则体现在参数中。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于重复测量和分层非线性模型的电池健康状态分析方法，通过正则化迭代广义最小二乘识别参数，有效区分测量噪声和单元间变异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a repeated measurements approach with hierarchical nonlinear modeling for battery SoH analysis, using regularized iterative generalized least squares to distinguish measurement noise and cell-to-cell variation.
